Hi all, this is Mounika, a 5th sem  medical student
This is online E log book to discuss our patients health data shared after taking his guardians informed consent form

HISTORY:

A 36yr old female resident of ammanbol came to OPD with chief complaints of raise in body temperature, headche and neckpain.

HOPI:
 Pateint was asymptomatic one day back . from Tuesday afternoon she observed raise of temperature after she has done household chores which is associated with headache and neckpain.
Fever is not associated with chills. 
she took a tablet without eating and had an episode of vomting.and at night she took another tablet without eating had another episode of vomiting ,even after taking medications , there is high raise of body temperature .so she was taken to a RMP doctor and was given Dolo 650 and an injection.
-No complaints of burning micturition, pain abdomen, loose stools, cough, cold, SOB

Daily routine:
she wakesup at 6am and will do her household chores .
 she did a handloom work for  one month . 

Past illness:
Not a known case of asthma, HTN,DM,TB and any CVS diseases, epilepsy.

Treatment history:
Not significant

Personal history:
Diet: mixed
Sleep: adequate
Bowel and bladder movements: normal
Habits: none

Family history :
Not significant

 weakness at the time of admission.

ABDOMEN

Treatment:

 1) InjPAN .40mg..IV OD
